name: TPS54302
description: 28 V, 3 A synchronous buck in SOT-23-6 with internal compensation: a drop-in upgrade of the TPS54202 for heavier 5 V loads.
notes: 28 V max: fine for 12 V and up to 5S Li-ion, not for 24 V systems with charging spikes.

en.note: Internal pull-up current (Ip 0.7 µA, +Ih 1.55 µA hysteresis); float EN to enable. Rising threshold 1.23 V typ, falling 1.16 V typ. Recommended operating max 5.5 V, so do not tie to VIN. Use open-drain logic to control. Optional UVLO divider R4 (VIN-EN) / R5 (EN-GND) per eq. 1-2; typical app (Fig 7-1, 8-28 V in) µses R4 = 511k, R5 = 105k.

notes: Fixed 400 kHz (290-510 kHz), +/-6% spread spectrum; Eco-mode pulse skipping below ~500 mA peak inductor current (no FCCM option).
Internally compensated peak current mode. Keep crossover < 40 kHz; without Cff, fo ~= 5.1 / (VOUT x CO) (eq. 14, CO in F).

Cff (C6, across top resistor R2) = 1 / (2*pi*fo*R2) (eq. 16); 75 pF in the 5 V design. Not needed with high-ESR COUT; reduce it with medium-ESR COUT. Table 7-2 labels this column C8 but it is the same feed-forward cap.
LMIN = VOUT*(VINmax-VOUT)/(VINmax*KIND*IOUT*fSW) (eq. 8); higher KIND allowed with ceramic COUT (design example µses 0.35), KIND = 0.2 with higher-ESR caps.
Output cap: CO >= 2*dIOUT/(fSW*dVOUT) for load step (eq. 11); typical app 2 x 22 µF 25 V X7R.
Input: >10 µF ceramic decoupling (typical app 10 µF), optional 0.1 µF HF cap; add ~47 µF electrolytic bulk if the supply is more than a few inches away.
Datasheet suggests R2 (top) ~100k; 49.9 ohm R1 in series with the top resistor in Fig 7-1 is only a loop-injection point (optional).
Can run at 100% duty cycle while BOOT-SW > 2.1 V. Internal 5 ms soft start. Hiccup OCP. High-side limit 4-6 A (5 A typ), low-side valley limit 4 A typ.
Datasheet gives no explicit VOUT range; catalog vout 0.6-26 V is not stated in the datasheet.
design.pages: SLVSDG6C (Rev C, Mar 2026). Pin functions p3; abs max (EN 7 V, VIN 30 V) and rec.
